text:
Maya: Quick non-serious poll: if your desk had a mascot, what would it be? Pics and names encouraged. :dog2:
Evan: A tiny rubber T-Rex named 'Meetingsaurus' that roars at calendar invites :t_rex:
Diego: A succulent named 'Persephone' because it survives my neglect and still looks fancy :herb:
Nora: A miniature disco ball called 'Focus Sphere' for when morale dips :sparkles:
Maya: Love it. rules: must be desk-sized, not alive (so no office hamsters), and has a personality trait in the name
Evan: also it plays a single song on loop when you hit "start standup" (obv)
Diego: here is my entry: Persephone, queen of low-water plants. she is inscrutable and judges my snack choices. (imagine a tiny crown)
Nora: Focus Sphere is 'low-key dramatic' and throws tiny laser light when the build passes :star2:
Evan: Meetingsaurus is 'punctual but loud' and only allows short updates then stomps away
Maya: OpsBot: can we get a poll? :grin:
OpsBot: Poll created: "Pick a desk mascot" (options: Meetingsaurus, Persephone, Focus Sphere, Surprise Me). Voting open for 24 hours.
Diego: Surprise Me should be a random mystery box. like 'mystery platypus' just to mess with people
Nora: If Surprise Me wins the winner has to actually bring an odd prop and leave it on the shelf in the kitchen for a week
Evan: Deal. I'll craft a tiny T-Rex out of sticky notes if Meetingsaurus wins :memo:
Maya: Also props for inventing lore. we should write bios for these mascots and put them in the handbook jokes section :laughing:
Nora: Bio starter for Focus Sphere: "Once a humble ornament, now arbiter of snack disputes."
Diego: Persephone's bio: "Thrive-on-neglect goddess. Offers silent solidarity during late deploys."
Evan: Meetingsaurus: "Champion of concise updates. Believes in victory by elbowing through the agenda."
Maya: Voting results will determine who brings the prop. please vote if you care at all. low stakes, high joy :tada:
OpsBot: Poll closed. Results: Meetingsaurus 40%, Persephone 30%, Focus Sphere 20%, Surprise Me 10%.
Maya: Meetingsaurus wins! Evan, we expect a sticky-note T-Rex by Friday. :t_rex:
Evan: Challenge accepted. I will sculpt and ceremonially place Meetingsaurus at the monitor base
Nora: Can't wait to see the tiny tyrant judge our standups
Diego: If it survives post-Friday I'm adopting Persephone's crown inspiration for my plant pot
Maya: Thread archived unless someone has dramatic prop objections :smile:
